card.title: kanban: HTTP API, SSE stream and watcher
card.summary: The server that serves the snapshot over HTTP and pushes deltas over SSE. A watcher rescans the column folders every 300 ms. A change on disk reaches open pages within 500 ms.
card.author: raouf

body:
## Description

The server that serves the snapshot over HTTP and pushes deltas over SSE.

Done when: a change on disk reaches open pages within 500 ms.

## Implementation plan

1. Routes and health.
2. The watcher and its delta.
